title: Penstock project configuration
description: Configuration for the Penstock BPMN editor. A file in a subfolder overrides the one above it, and the file nearest a diagram wins.

engine.description: Which engine the diagrams target. Decides the palette, the properties panel and what deploy does.

schema.description: How shapes are drawn. 'sketchy' renders the diagram hand-drawn.

scriptType.description: Default language for script tasks. Camunda 7 only.

labels.description: Show a text label under every toolbar button.

tree.description: Show the diagram tree in the Penstock tool window.

elementTemplates.description: Folders and files to read Camunda element templates from, relative to this file.

lint.description: bpmnlint wiring. All three paths are needed before linting runs.

clientBundlePath.description: Path to the bundled browser build of the rules.

nodesep.description: Space between two shapes in the same column.

marginX.description: Left and right margin inside a container.

marginY.description: Top and bottom margin inside a container.

deployment.description: Where deploy sends the diagram. Passwords and secrets are never read from this file - they live in the IDE password safe.

camunda7Url.description: Camunda 7 REST API, for example http://localhost:8080/engine-rest.

name.description: Deployment name shown in the engine.

tenantId.description: Tenant to deploy to. Empty means the default tenant.

source.description: Deployment source recorded by the engine.

duplicateFiltering.description: Skip a deployment identical to the last one.

changedOnly.description: Send only the diagrams that changed.

activationTime.description: ISO timestamp the deployment becomes active.

type.description: How to authenticate against the engine.

username.description: Basic auth user. The password lives in the IDE password safe.

clientId.description: OAuth client id. The secret lives in the IDE password safe.
